text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: —The dream shattered.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Yet my resolve will not scatter.
Deep within my chest, it still awaits the fulfillment of my great wish.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: If what is demanded of the one at the top is strength, then there is still a chance left.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"Indeed. In the race where the strongest is said to emerge victorious—
the Kikuka Sho—"

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
—Allow me to show you
the pride of the “Emperor.”
And so, it was decided that we would proceed to the Kikuka Sho as planned.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Good work, Madam President.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
While the result was unfortunate,
it was truly a dignified and magnificent run.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Thank you, Air Groove.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I failed to live up to your expectations this time,
but I promise I will bring home victory next time.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Then, as expected—

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Naturally, next is the Kikuka Sho.
I have no intention of halting my stride.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
I am equally confident that
the President will achieve great success.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: However, if that happens, she will be busier than ever going forward.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Even though summer's starting, media interviews will only increase,
and summer is when the Student Council—

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: President?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
...Ah, I'm listening.
Please continue.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"...Forgive me for saying so, but you look
a bit exhausted."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"Haha. Even I can't stay in high spirits
right after a race, you know."

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: "...Perhaps you should ease up on your student council duties a bit—"

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I believe that matter has already been settled.
Let's talk about something more constructive instead.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Just as you were about to say, the student council has important duties in the summer, after all.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: You should know, Trainer-kun.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
The annual summer training camp held to hone our skills.
We're also involved in running it, you see.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Oh, right, Air Groove.
Can you get in touch with the bus company?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
There's a change in the number of units.
Well, and there's something else I want to discuss.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: "However, I need to handle the press waiting outside, so... let's see."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"I will return to the academy in two hours.
Please proceed with the preparations for the meeting by then."

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Understood completely.

Even after a race as grueling
as the Japan Derby,
Symboli Rudolf remained unchanged as ever.
